about_the_game:
PIONER is an open-world MMO first-person shooter set in a haunting, alternative-reality world where Soviet-era structures lie abandoned on a desolate, post-apocalyptic island. In this immersive environment, the gameplay experience is defined by dynamic PvE and PvP elements, where realism takes priority over traditional health bars or character levels. With a sprawling map of 50+ square kilometers, not counting hidden dungeons, players can explore a world rich with mystery and danger, encountering story quests and faction missions that influence relationships and loyalty rewards.

This Demo delivers a robust  slice of the full experience, letting you explore key areas, quests, and activities focusing on solo journey. 

Prologue & Tutorial

Encounter pivotal characters, uncover early plot twists, and set the stage for the larger narrative that awaits in the full game.

Hub Location

Discover the single-player version of this bustling hub town, where you can engage in events, unearth hidden lore, and enjoy a variety of mini-games is included in the Demo, but you’ll still get a glimpse of the social and exploratory elements at the heart of PIONER.

Manufacture Raid

Take on Manufacture — a high-stakes raid zone deep within a decaying industrial megastructure, where hostile factions, deadly traps, and rare loot await only the most prepared adventurers.

Additional Activities

  • Mini-Games: Dive into a variety of fun distractions within the hub.

  • Single-Player CCG Carnage: Test your strategic prowess in the collectible card game adapted for solo play.

Get a feel for PIONER’s core mechanics, grim atmosphere, and survival challenges in this extended demo. We hope you'll enjoy the demo!

short_description: PIONER drops players into a vast, grim world, where survival hinges on exploration, crafting, and smart resource management. As an MMO FPS, it offers both PvE missions and intense PvP zones, with unique crafting mechanics, hundreds of weapons and a deep story to explore.
